recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless the Clinical Genomics work group reintroduces a current-build sequence repository backbone and wants the historical repository type semantics reviewed.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive DSTU2 issue requested adding a required code element named type under Sequence.repository, bound to repositoryType, to distinguish repository access modes.
initial_application: Git commit 77a5d706c4 explicitly applied #11018 by adding Sequence.repository.type as a 1..1 code with a repositoryType binding and repository access codes in source/sequence/sequence-spreadsheet.xml.
additional_context: Sequence was later renamed to MolecularSequence by 78abae0217. Current source/fhir.ini omits Sequence from active resources, lists Sequence under removed resources, and comments out MolecularSequence in current build metadata. Current source has no active Sequence.repository or MolecularSequence.repository element to correct; remaining repositoryType hits are CQL model-info remnants rather than an active resource definition for this tracker.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo/out-of-current-build audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were changed because the requested change was already applied historically and the affected artifact is outside the current core build scope.
